landing.title: English that talks back
landing.subtitle: Ustoz is your personal AI tutor: real conversations, instant feedback on mistakes, a pronunciation coach and a personal plan of bite-sized quizzes.
landing.demoUser: Hi! I has a big family.
landing.demoTutor: Great! How many brothers and sisters do you have?
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to start speaking
landing.f1Text: Talk about anything — from plov and Chorsu bazaar to a job interview at a tech company.
landing.f2Text: Every message is checked: the fix, the rule and examples — in your language.
landing.f3Text: Listen to a model, record yourself and get tips on tricky sounds like th, w and r.
landing.f4Title: A plan that feels like a game
landing.f4Text: Short quizzes, streaks, XP and levels — learning becomes a habit.
landing.f5Text: A quick test finds your level from A1 to C2, and the tutor adapts to you.
landing.f6Text: Interface and explanations in Russian, Uzbek or English.
landing.how2: Chat with your tutor 10–15 minutes a day
landing.how3: Lock in your mistakes with personal quizzes
landing.pricingSubtitle: Start for free. Go Pro whenever you want more.
landing.proF1: All levels A1–C2 and every topic
landing.q1: Do I need to install anything?
landing.a1: No. Ustoz runs in the browser on your phone and computer. For pronunciation, Chrome or Edge works best.
landing.a2: After signing up you take a short 8-question test. You can change your level in settings any time.
landing.q3: What happens when my 15 minutes are up?
landing.a3: On the Free plan you continue tomorrow — the limit resets at midnight Tashkent time.
landing.q4: How do I pay for Pro?
landing.a4: Payments via Payme, Click and Uzcard are coming very soon.
